brief:
Police conducted searches of the homes of elderly activists associated with Palestine Action, confiscating personal devices and other items during the operations, Middle East Eye reported. The activists expressed alarm at the scope of the raids, with some characterizing the searches as a stark departure from the Britain they had grown up in.

The specific legal grounds for the police action and the allegations investigators were pursuing remained unclear from available accounts. Palestine Action has organized demonstrations and direct actions related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The activists said police searched their entire homes during the raids.

title: Police raid elderly activists' homes over Palestine Action videos
